title: mobile friendly payment options
name: Mobile friendly payment options — NN/g
rule: Mobile-friendly payment options without overwhelming; photo-to-fill card; cross-device cart.
pass_when: Payment options stay usable on mobile without an overwhelming list; card can be filled from a photo; cart works across devices.
fail_when: Overwhelming payment list, no photo-to-fill where the article’s pattern applies, or cart that cannot continue on another device.
overview: Mobile payments stay usable; support photo-to-fill and cross-device cart.
apply_when: Mobile checkout payment options, card entry, and multi-device carts.
not_when: Overwhelming payment lists or carts that cannot continue on another device.
agent_hint: Keep mobile payments manageable; enable photo-to-fill card and cross-device cart.
description: Offer mobile-friendly payment options without overwhelming the list. Support photo-to-fill for cards and a cart that works across devices. Pass when payment options stay usable on mobile without an overwhelming list, card can be filled from a photo, and cart works across devices. Fail when the payment list overwhelms, photo-to-fill is missing where the pattern applies, or the cart cannot continue on another device.
do_not_claim: A required set of named wallets.
